text_block_list.text:
I searched for Neo Universe, who hadn't shown up despite it being time for training,
and found her on the rooftop...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's about time... it comes.
The first fixed star...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Searching for "signals" from the target...
Today, for sure... I will find the "CMIN"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that voice just now...?
It came from... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Consciousness dissociating from the ground...
I'm going to say "I'm sorry."

Neo Universe seemed to regret
forgetting about her training.
I made sure to firmly remind her to be careful next time.
